description: Answers 'what is affected if this concept changes?' for a governed type, element or controlled vocabulary. Returns: where it is used inside the model (blast radius), which vendor estates carry it and by what path, which external standards it is bound to, and which serializations it can be exported as. Read-only — nothing is modified. Useful before editing a vocabulary term or a column's meaning.

concept.description: The governed type, element or taxonomy — by node id, or by label (case-insensitive), e.g. 'order status values' or 'status'.

name: analyze_concept_impact
title: Analyze Concept Impact
